messages:
rhea (People Ops): Quick orchestration note for this cycle  trying staggered deadlines to reduce last-hour churn. Please read.
rhea (People Ops): New cadence: teams in APAC/EU have an earlier soft deadline (Thu 11:59pm local) for reviews so managers can prep before the global hard deadline (Sun 11:59pm PT). This is optional but recommended for cross-timezone teams.
omar (People Ops): Implementation notes: in the signup sheet put a timezone column and pick "staggered" if you want an earlier prep window. We'll try to honor the stagger and allocate calibration slots accordingly.
nate (Eng Manager): How will calibration slots be allocated? We have mixed-region reports and don't want people forced into odd hours.
rhea (People Ops): Slots will be zoned: mornings for APAC, midday for EMEA, afternoons for AMER. If you have mixed reports, mark "mixed" and we'll split your team's slots across the bands.
syl (IC): About visibility: when will ICs see manager feedback? Last cycle there was confusion about edits after sharing.
omar (People Ops): Default remains "share after calibration". Managers can toggle "share draft" to share earlier, but please avoid absolute language since outcomes can change.
anya (Recruiting): Small ask: if someone joined mid-cycle, should we attach interview notes to help calibration? We have a few hires from the last 6 weeks.
rhea (People Ops): Yes, attach a short hiring-context note named "hire-ctx-<last>-<first>.pdf" or paste a 1-line context in manager_summary. For <6w hires mark "early-data" so calibrators see quicker context.
nate (Eng Manager): CSV import headaches again  what headers do you need for staggered uploads?
omar (People Ops): Import expects exactly: employee_email,manager_summary,stagger_tag (values: early/mixed/standard). Use the validator link in #review-ops before upload.
rhea (People Ops): New helper: we published a "stagger cheat-sheet" with example manager_summary snippets and a small triage flow. Will drop in #review-ops in 20m.
forms-bot: Reminder scheduled: global review forms hard deadline in ~72 hours. Forms: https://app.redwood/reviews
syl (IC): Appreciate the stagger idea  saves late-night work.
nate (Eng Manager): We'll mark our team as mixed and try the staggered slots. Thanks.
rhea (People Ops): Thanks all  ping @omar or me in-thread if you hit import errors or need an exception. We'll keep an eye on the signup sheet. :sparkles:
